verdict.what_happens: The 1 kg weight drops onto one end of the seesaw, launching the initially resting 100 g ball from the other end. The ball rises about 2.0 m above its starting height, then lands and settles on the seesaw. Both balls are at rest at 6 s.

usage.text:
The 1 kg weight falls onto the left end of the seesaw at about 0.65 s, rotating it and launching the 100 g ball from the right end. The ball rises from approximately 0.475 m to 2.47 m—a gain of about 2.0 m, comfortably exceeding the required 50 cm.

The weight settles on the floor. The launched ball lands, briefly contacts the weight, then settles on the seesaw. Both balls are at rest by the end of the 6 s run. The scene satisfies the brief.
